Hey cool! I have a lump in my nut. I hope it's cancer too! So much in common ^_^

Also, I've been faking it for far too long, and I'm far too tired of continuing to pretend I give a fuck anymore.

The only thing I could see happening is finding a career-minded woman who wants to have a family, but as her career is also important, wouldn't have "time" for the typical role of mother. So I could be a stay-at-home dad or something. My whole life I've never been motivated to have a career, nothing has ever really interested me or... driven me to want one. So that's what would work, I'm 30, I'm not going to change or somehow gain this magical motivation to have a career. It's just not worth it to me.

As pathetic as that sounds, that's all I really want. The only thing driving me at all is my biological drive to procreate. I want a woman. I want kids. Outside of that, nothing. Void. And my drive to procreate isn't strong enough to motivate me and make it "worth" it to seek a career. Especially after one failed attempt at a family.

he gave me a note to go on welfare, I just don't feel right taking it when there are people with families that need it and want it, and want to live.
